source_text: The debate underscored empirical data: prophylactic benefits like a 90% relative reduction in urinary tract infections (absolute risk reduction of about 1%) cited by proponents were deemed insufficient by the court to override autonomy for healthy infants, given complication rates of 0.2-0.6% including meatal stenosis and adhesions. [63]
